 Print Sooraj Barjatya ’s 'Yeh Prem Mol Liya' team is heading to 'The Great Indian Kapil Show', and Kapil Sharma has shared a trailer for the episode. In true Barjatya style, the promo looks like a cosy family gathering, featuring Sooraj, Ayushmann Khurrana , Sharvari, Seema Pahwa , Supriya Pathak, Saumya Tandon and Swanand Kirkire. Sooraj Barjatya on marrying before his first film
 In the promo, Kapil quipped that, for the first time, there were as many people on stage as there were in the audience. During the conversation, Sooraj shared that his mother had made him get married before directing his first film, fearing he might fall for an actor and end up marrying her. Watch SRK reacts to Suhana's Diwali video as Ayushmann and Rajkummar groove at Mumbai party Ayushmann Khurrana on refusing sehra and ghodi at his wedding
 Drawing a parallel with Sooraj, Ayushmann joked that he had also married early. He shared that at his wedding to Tahira Kashyap , he had flatly refused to wear a sehra (a floral headdress worn by grooms) or climb onto a horse. Yet, he laughed, Sooraj managed to make him do all the things he had steered clear of in real life for their upcoming film. Poll Vote & Share your view 
 Which actor are you most excited to see in 'Yeh Prem Mol Liya'? Ayushmann Khurrana Anupam Kher 3k+ users shared opinion today 5k+ users already voted today 3k+ users shared opinion today Share Opinion 'Yeh Prem Mol Liya' cast and crew
 'Yeh Prem Mol Liya', directed by Sooraj Barjatya, has Ayushmann Khurrana and Sharvari in the lead roles, with Anupam Kher, Seema Pahwa, Supriya Pathak, Saumya Tandon and Swanand Kirkire in supporting parts. Rajshri Productions has produced the film in association with Mahaveer Jain Films, and Himesh Reshammiya has composed the music. The film sees Sooraj return to the director’s chair after 'Uunchai' (2022), and also brings him back together with Himesh Reshammiya, whom he last worked with on 'Prem Ratan Dhan Payo' (2015). The film is slated to hit theatres on November 27, 2026.
